notes: This template is not evidence and intentionally sets configured=false.
Set configured=true only after real_workload_dir points at a real checkout and command_template runs the paper macro benchmark for the requested cell.
The command/env/cwd template must preserve dataset, benchmark, allocator, variant_feature, and run_index placeholders; the template env exports these as UNIALLOC_PAPER_* values for wrapper harnesses.
Set benchmark_owned_json=true only after the real benchmark harness itself prints finite JSON timing for the selected cell.
